title: Understanding MSE on Test Data
text: When you remove a feature from a model, think about how it might affect the model's ability to generalize to new data. Consider how the complexity of the model changes and how that might impact the MSE on held-out test data.

title: Effect of Feature Removal on Model Complexity
text: Removing a feature from a model generally leads to a decrease in model complexity. How might this change affect the model's performance on unseen data?

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Consider the bias-variance tradeoff when a feature is removed. How might this tradeoff influence the MSE on held-out test data?

title: Impact on Bias and Variance
text: Removing a feature can increase bias but decrease variance. How might these changes affect the MSE on held-out test data?
